actors.name: End User
actors.description: A person using the system for its intended purpose

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: A person with privileged access to operate or configure the system

actors.name: External Attacker
actors.description: A person outside the boundary trying to reach what is inside it

actors.name: Web Browser
actors.description: A browser running the system's own front end

actors.name: Mobile App
actors.description: An application on a phone or tablet

actors.name: Desktop App
actors.description: An application installed on a workstation

actors.name: API Client
actors.description: A program calling the system's interface directly

actors.name: IoT Device
actors.description: A device in the field reporting to or driven by the system

actors.name: Partner System
actors.description: A system run by another organisation that exchanges data with this one
